wu: Stand Up Sit Down Game: Teacher calls out 'stand up' or 'sit down', children jump up or down quickly. Teacher speeds up to make it fun. Children shout 'Yes!' when they do it right.
wuAlt: Simon Says: Teacher says 'Simon says stand up', children obey; if no 'Simon says', they freeze. Children laugh when tricked.
Hello Circle: Children stand in a circle, pass a ball, say 'Hello, my name is [name]' when they get the ball.
pres: Use flashcards showing 'stand up', 'sit down', 'look', 'listen'. Teacher models each action with clear commands: 'Stand up! Now sit down.' Children repeat the words and actions. Teacher asks 'What do I do?' to check understanding.
presAlt: Puppet Show: A puppet gives wrong commands (e.g., 'Sit down!' while standing), children correct it by saying the right action. Puppet says 'Oh, sorry!'.
Realia Demo: Teacher uses a doll to show 'look' at the doll, 'listen' to a bell, children copy and say the words.
prac: Command Relay: Teams line up, teacher whispers a command to the first child, they run to the board, draw it, next child says the command. Teacher helps with spelling if needed. Teams cheer when they get it right.
pracAlt: Classroom Routine Bingo: Children have bingo cards with pictures of actions (stand, sit, look, listen). Teacher calls out commands, children mark the picture. First to shout 'Bingo!' wins.
Action Charades: One child mimes an action, others guess and say the command. Mimes 'stand up' if correct.
ls: Listen and Draw Audio: Play a short audio of a teacher giving 3 commands (e.g., 'Stand up. Look at the board. Sit down.'). Children draw the actions in order. Teacher checks drawings to see if they followed correctly.
re: Freeze Dance: Play music, children dance; when music stops, teacher shouts a command (e.g., 'sit down'), children freeze in that position. Laugh if someone moves too soon.
prod: Classroom Rules Poster: Groups of 3 draw 3 rules (e.g., 'Stand up when the teacher comes in', 'Listen when the teacher speaks') on a poster. Each group presents their poster, saying the rules clearly.
rw: Read and Match: Children read short sentences ('When the teacher claps, sit down.') and match them to picture cards of classroom situations. Teacher helps with unknown words.
st: Goodbye Song: Sing 'Goodbye, goodbye, see you next time!' with waving motions. Children line up for a high-five and get a sticker for the sticker chart. Teacher says 'Goodbye, [name]!' to each child.
g: Teacher says 'Simon says [action]', children obey; if no 'Simon says', they freeze.
Teams race to draw or act out commands first.
Dance until music stops, then freeze when a command is called.
Mark pictures of actions as commands are called.
Mime actions for others to guess the command.
diff: Fast finishers: Write a 4th rule for the poster with a drawing.
Support: Trace the words 'stand up', 'sit down' on the poster.
hw: Draw a picture of your favorite classroom routine and write 1 sentence about it.
Ask your family 3 classroom rules in English and tell the class next week.
Make a list of 3 greetings (hello, goodbye) and practice saying them in a mirror.
tip: Use the American Space Oujda poster to model greetings; connect to local culture by saying 'Salam alaikum' as a hello, then teach 'Hello' as the English version.
